dialogue_texts: Oh, my. She was talking as if the foundations were solid things.
Glohm is no use... it could redefine boundaries in seconds.
And it won't be new reality.
Berenice's caught up in my broom.
She won't sweep what we decide as part of the world.
She'll simply adjust the boundaries between dust and scenery.
But to rewrite the logic of the world so casually... who exactly is she!?
Listen to me, My Majesty. There could be one final shard to this incident.
I think the glohm experiment must have started in the Scarlet Devil Mansion.
Going there should hopefully stabilize the border.
I cannot allow this to happen again, so please go there if you can.
I wish I could, though I must say that understanding her fundamental logic was... taxing.
You must be all tired from that fighting, My Majesty. I can give you a night in the mansion to rest up.
I'm glad you're staying because do you want to witness something spectacular?
We have to wait until the sun sets, which won't be until a few hours.
The sun's disc is almost past the horizon. Wait for it...
How do you look much crisper at night?
Night is where my true strength lies. This was the reason my partner and I got close. Our first dance clearly showed we'd be together.
How romantic! But in my life, the night is less about destiny and what hides within the shadows.
Same thing here. When my partner's not present, I feel lonely like a princess in a tower.
Even the most beautiful tower is eventually swept away by time.
Rest then, My Majesty. Tomorrow's world will still be there, and everything we've been through today will be nothing more than a bad dream.
For me, it was simply a bit of housekeeping.
Congratulations! Good ending! Tomorrow on the agenda is the Scarlet Devil Mansion, where the Extra Stage awaits.
